meaning.zh:
“去世” 或 “死亡”。

这个短语的起源可以追溯到老式洗衣杆系统。当衣物在晾衣绳上晾干时，人们用木夹子（peg）固定住，如果衣物晾干了，人们会把木夹子拔掉（peg out）。这引申为人生命的结束，意味着人离开了这个世间。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from the old-fashioned clothesline system. When clothes were hung out to dry, they were secured with wooden pegs. Once the clothes were dried, the pegs were removed (pegged out). This has been metaphorically extended to mean the end of life, implying a person has left this world.

lines.en: Many of the older generations have *pegged out* by now.
lines.zh: 很多老一辈的人现在已经去世了。

lines.en: He suddenly *pegged out* during dinner last night.
lines.zh: 他昨晚在吃晚餐时突然去世了。

lines.en: She was so shocked to hear that her old friend had finally *pegged out*.
lines.zh: 她听到她的老朋友终于去世的消息时非常震惊。
